headline: New test: sparse selected series across wide head yields one block
summary: Adds a test where an unselected filler series stretches head.MaxTime to 10500 while the selected series covers only [100,200]. It checks that CompactSelectedSeries produces exactly one block with the selected-series hint, one series and two samples, and no extra ULID directories on disk from the ten empty chunk-range iterations. It is a new test file entry with no production effect, so a short summary is enough.
